correctness.rationale: Starting from the original two-stage GeCo2 update for symmetric A=[[-1,1],[1,-1]], A^2=-2A and z=2h give x_{n+1}=x_n[1-t(z)phi(b(z)|x_n|/(1+|x_n|))] with t=z(1+e^-z)/2 and b=z(1+e^-z)-2(1-e^-z)>0. The unique threshold t(zc)=2 is zc~3.922359502743079. At zc, p(r)=tphi(br/(1+r))-1 decreases strictly from 1 to a value between 0 and 1; hence all positive amplitudes tend to zero with alternating sign and p(r)=1-bc r+O(r²) gives n r_n->1/bc. For z>zc, p(0)>1>p(1)>0, so unique r_z in (0,1) with p=1 creates a primitive symmetric two-cycle, and derivative mu=1-(2-t exp(-v))(1-v/b) lies strictly inside (-1,1), giving local attraction. Implicit differentiation at threshold proves linear onset; z->infty root squeezing gives r_z->1/3 and mu->-1/2. Independently recomputed roots and multipliers at z=4,5,7,50,200 and critical constant; the analytic proof, not finite samples, establishes every step and all initializations at criticality.

originality.rationale: Qualified best-of-knowledge: the source Izgin–Kopecz–Martiradonna–Meister 2023 establishes the GeCo2 recurrence, hyperbolic local stability function, and numerical post-threshold oscillations. Materially inspected sections do not give a global critical 1/n law, a proved locally attracting symmetric two-cycle for all supercritical steps, exact Floquet multiplier, onset or stiff limit; the current contribution is method-specific nonlinear dynamics. General flip bifurcation theory is acknowledged; the nonsmooth x|x| onset is not a generic analytic square-root claim.
